cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 500: 30 displayed points from 50 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 400–500: all 11 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 674.700, interval [619.528, 740.618]. Paired change versus generation 490: -18.940, 95% interval [-66.597, 33.166]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 6,400 games; 50 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 203.800.
